label: Mortgage
tagline: Pipeline, risk, and underwriting intelligence that prevents silent losses.
narrative: Watch the loan funnel, rate-lock fallout, underwriting cycle times, and early delinquency risk signals. Detect anomalies that indicate leakage or adverse selection.

recommended_actions.title: Rebalance underwriting capacity
recommended_actions.detail: Shift queue to reduce UW cycle time spikes; auto-assign by complexity bands.

recommended_actions.title: Fallout intervention
recommended_actions.detail: Trigger outreach + pricing review when rate-lock fallout jumps > 2σ.

recommended_actions.title: Risk tightening
recommended_actions.detail: If early risk score rises, recommend policy review for top contributing segments.

alerts_catalog.description: Underwriting cycle time exceeds baseline sharply.
Rate-lock fallout spike indicates revenue leakage.
